components.name: Magma Spitter
components.blurb: Spits slag that keeps eating after it lands. The breech room is aired out with every shot, which the Basalt consider polite.
components.quirk: Slag glob plus acid that burns on for 4 s and may creep to a neighbouring cell (15% a tick; +30% damage a second over a Mk2 pulse), but each shot vents 30% of its room's air: Basalt do not breathe.

components.name: Quarry Driver
components.blurb: A quarry slug on a rail. It goes through what you point it at and a few things behind. The room airs out; the Basalt call it a breeze.
components.quirk: A 9-damage slug that pierces 3, but it is slow, and each shot vents 40% of its room's air: Basalt do not breathe.

components.name: Pumice Flak
components.blurb: Throws rock in handfuls. It aims best in the dark and the quiet, where the old hands run it.
components.quirk: A splashing flak turret, but at half damage unless a Basalt mans it: they work it airless, steady and unbothered.

components.name: Vacuum Forge
components.blurb: A reactor that runs best with no air in the way. It lets the room out through a polite little valve. The Basalt do not notice.
components.quirk: +3 power over a Reactor Mk1 (11 against 8), but it vents 5% of its room's air a second: Basalt do not breathe.

components.name: Stonehide Plating Bay
components.blurb: Quarried plate laid thick over every wall of the room. The walls are very sure of themselves. The air is not invited.
components.quirk: The walls of its room get +50% hp in a fight, but the room cannot keep its air (3% a second): Basalt do not breathe.

components.name: Gravity Anchor
components.blurb: A heavy core that makes the whole ship hard to push around. It pulls on everything near it, air included, and says nothing about it.
components.quirk: The ship turns 50% faster while it works, ram damage to its plain cells is x0.35 and the crew keep their feet in a ram, but it pulls the air out of its room (3% a second): Basalt do not breathe.
